description: This file defines the 'LoanAccountDomainService' interface in the 'org.apache.fineract.portfolio.loanaccount.domain' package, specifying various methods for managing loan transactions such as repayment, refund, disbursement, charge payments, foreclosure, and collateral updates within the Fineract loan portfolio module.

classes.name: LoanAccountDomainService
classes.description: Interface providing services for managing loan account transactions such as repayment, refund, disbursement, foreclosure, and collateral management within the loan portfolio.

methods.name: makeRepayment
methods.description: Performs a loan repayment transaction with detailed parameters including transaction type, date, amount, payment details, and various flags to handle specific repayment scenarios.

methods.name: makeRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund for a loan, updating the loan's state and generating the necessary transaction records.

methods.name: makeDisburseTransaction
methods.description: Handles the disbursement of loan funds, creating a disbursement transaction for the specified loan and amount.

methods.name: reverseTransfer
methods.description: Reverses a specific loan transaction transfer, restoring previous states.

methods.name: makeChargePayment
methods.description: Records a payment made specifically towards a charge associated with a loan.

methods.name: makeRefundForActiveLoan
methods.description: Processes a refund on an active loan, updating relevant states and records.

methods.name: updateLoanCollateralStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of collateral linked to a loan, marking as released or otherwise.

methods.name: setLoanDelinquencyTag
methods.description: Assigns or removes delinquency tags to a loan based on overdue status and delinquency actions.

methods.name: foreCloseLoan
methods.description: Facilitates the foreclosure of a loan, closing it out at a specified date with optional changes.

methods.name: disableStandingInstructionsLinkedToClosedLoan
methods.description: Disables automatic instructions associated with a loan that has been closed.

methods.name: creditBalanceRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund from the credit balance of a loan.

methods.name: applyInterestRefund
methods.description: Applies an interest refund to a loan based on refund request data.

methods.name: updateAndSavePostDatedChecksForIndividualAccount
methods.description: Updates post-dated checks linked to a loan transaction for individual accounts.

methods.name: updateAndSaveLoanCollateralTransactionsForIndividualAccounts
methods.description: Updates collateral transactions related to a loan for individual accounts.

methods.name: createManualInterestRefundWithAmount
methods.description: Creates a manual interest refund transaction with a specified amount.
